thread:
alex: quick ping — PR #3128 is ready but needs one more approval to land in today's merge window. I addressed the naming nit taylor called out (userID -> user_id in proto jsonname) and pushed commit abc123. Ran gofumpt locally but CI is failing on a gofmt check pointing at vendor/third_party/generated.pb.go. Can someone spare a minute to re-review?

taylor: thanks for the fix. look ok overall. prefer adding a short comment in the proto so future folks know the jsonname intention. the vendor generated file should not be in the repo — that will trigger gofmt errors every CI run.

priya: agree with taylor. did you regenerate with the repo's proto tool? (`make proto_gen`) If you committed generated output from a dependency, that explains the lint failure.

alex: i did `make proto_gen` before committing, but i noticed the generated file lived under vendor/third_party so i removed it from the commit and force-pushed (abc124). requeued CI. command i ran: ```bash
make proto_gen && git add -A && git commit -m "proto: jsonname user_id; regen" && git push --force
```

ci-bot: CI queued: linux-gofmt, unit-tests, integration-smoke. linux-gofmt started.

alex: thanks. re: the proto comment i'll add a one-liner in the next small commit if you want it in this PR or i can follow up in a separate PR.

taylor: tiny nit only: rename local var `tmp` -> `tmpBuf` in handler_test.go for readability, not blocking. approving after that if someone else ok. :thumbsup:

priya: i'm +1, will approve. also please ensure there's a changelog entry for the proto jsonname change (internal note), not user-facing but helpful for audits.

alex: noted — added comment and changelog snippet in abc125. thanks both. merging once linux-gofmt passes.

ci-bot: linux-gofmt passed. unit-tests running.

ci-bot: unit-tests passed. mergeable.

alex: merged. if anything flares up i'll open a followup to exclude vendor generated files from lint and add a note to the dev docs on proto regeneration. thanks all :tada:
